mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag on corporate earnings and equity prices, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating industrial production index signals strengthening economic activity that will boost corporate earnings and equity prices, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months with accelerating IP

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market that will drag on consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day SPX returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve (10Y-2Y spread) signals a tightening financial conditions that will compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns, especially if accompanied by an inverted curve.
failure_condition: 20-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months with flattening/inverting yield curve

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts signals strengthening residential investment that will boost economic activity and equity prices, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months with rising housing starts

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will crash consumer spending and equity prices, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day SPX returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A spike in inflation expectations (10Y breakeven rate) signals rising input costs that will compress corporate profit margins and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day SPX returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A collapse in consumer confidence signals a rapidly weakening consumer sector that will crash retail sales and equity prices, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, especially if accompanied by a spike in jobless claims.
failure_condition: 5-day SPX returns are positive in > 70% of months with collapsing confidence and surging jobless claims
